## Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Use Case

Describe the problem this feature would solve or the use case it enables:

```rust
// Example of how you'd like to use this feature
use rui_native::{El, ...};

fn view(app: &App) -> El<App> {
    // Pseudocode or description of desired API
    new_feature(...)
}
```

## Proposed Solution

How should this feature work? Describe the API design or behavior.

## Alternative Solutions

Are there any workarounds or alternative approaches?

## Additional Context

- Is this related to any existing issues?
- Any design constraints or tradeoffs to consider?
- Platform-specific considerations (macOS/Windows/Linux/WASM)?

**Note:** Before implementing, please discuss the design here. API design is important to get right!
